Delton Technology.why: Server PCB maker: server PCBs are its main application and it serves 8 of the global top-10 server makers; revenue grows with CPU / AI server builds
Delton Technology.evidence: Delton Technology IR activity record: 2026-07 (09-15-2026): server PCBs are the company's main application, used in HPC, AI, storage servers and switches; it covers 8 of the global top-10 server manufacturers

players.product: Server PCBs (high-layer-count, high-speed boards for general-purpose and AI servers supporting Intel, AMD and Arm CPUs; PCIe 6.0 server PCBs in small-volume ramp), plus accelerator-card, optical-module and switch PCBs

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, broker strategy meetings): H1 2026 revenue RMB 43.88 hundred million (+80.98%) and net profit RMB 9.56 hundred million (+94.39%); main-business gross margin rose to 35.36% (+3.09 points) as the high-value product share rose; operating cash flow RMB 9.37 hundred million (+106.77%). Revenue from computing-power applications grew explosively and is the core growth engine.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue RMB 43.88 hundred million (+80.98%); net profit RMB 9.56 hundred million (+94.39%); GM 35.36%

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): R&D spending rose sharply in H1 2026 on AI computing; this year's new R&D projects centre on AI computing products, accelerator cards, optical-module products and switch products; some new lines and plants will come online progressively.

Management (IR record): the CCL the company uses is mainly high-speed material with little ordinary FR4, so material price increases are controllable; upstream copper foil and glass cloth capacity is expanding but PCB capacity is too, so raw-material supply tightness may persist and a fundamental easing will take time.

Management (IR record): PCIe 6.0 server PCBs carry substantially higher material grade and process requirements and therefore substantially higher value than PCIe 5.0; their shipments depend on CPU chip mass-production plans - small-volume shipments are expected this year and volume shipments next year. The company's products support Intel, AMD and Arm architecture chips; mainstream boards carry 1, 2 or 4 CPUs. It is already pre-researching the next generation.

Management (IR record): the company works with domestic brand server customers and ODMs and, through them, with domestic CSP customers; H1 2026 domestic revenue grew about 40% year on year to over RMB 9 hundred million.
quarterly_data.figure: Domestic revenue +about 40% to over RMB 9 hundred million (H1 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): capital expenditure is expected at around RMB 50-60 hundred million per year in 2026 and 2027, funded by own funds plus equity and debt financing. New overseas capacity: customer demand for overseas capacity is large and the company will expand it steadily.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex about RMB 50-60 hundred million per year (2026 and 2027)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): Huangshi Delton (standalone) H1 2026 revenue RMB 67,408.54 ten-thousand and net profit RMB 3,622.44 ten-thousand; the plant, originally for consumer, automotive and industrial-control boards, is being retrofitted and upgraded to expand server product capacity and will become the company's main domestic computing-server PCB base.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue RMB 67,408.54 ten-thousand; net profit RMB 3,622.44 ten-thousand (Huangshi, H1 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): as the industry expands high-end AI PCB capacity, advanced equipment for some processes has long lead times; the company placed and locked orders early from multiple domestic and overseas suppliers and found alternatives, and its expansion is proceeding normally.
